title: International Buffoons' Vacation
overview: "International Buffoons' Vacation" is The Grand Tour season 3, episode 8, where the hosts take an RV holiday in the Southwestern US, but quickly ditch their assigned RVs to buy and customize their own, leading to chaos, dune buggy racing, and a comical "burglary" at an RV park. The episode, released March 1, 2019, features the trio modifying vehicles like a tent-truck, a pub-RV, and a boat/toilet hybrid, and includes segments with American performance cars like the Corvette ZR-1, Cadillac CTS-V, and Jeep Grand Cherokee Trackhawk.
